items.title: Ireland excludes crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
items.summary: Ireland’s planned investment accounts will offer tax benefits for stocks, bonds and ETFs, while excluding crypto and derivatives as higher-risk products.

items.title: Strive buys 1,800 Bitcoin for $143M, becomes fifth-biggest corporate holder
items.summary: Strive’s latest Bitcoin purchase lifted its holdings to 23,156 BTC, making it the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate holder as crypto markets rebound.

items.title: Ireland bars crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
items.summary: Eligible assets for the new accounts include listed stocks, bonds, and ETFs, with providers handling tax reporting to simplify investor compliance.

items.title: Metaplanet moves 4,800 BTC worth $377M to Coinbase
items.summary: The Japanese Bitcoin treasury company has transferred 10,270 BTC to Coinbase Prime this week, an amount equal to more than 29% of its reported holdings.
